summary: Frontend-only verification for kid-friendly senses grammar app. All 6 requested checks pass: (1) 4 module cards render on Home; (2) the chevron circle (26x26 goCircle) is fully INSIDE each of the 4 cards' bounds (no overflow) — measured via getBoundingClientRect: chevron right/bottom < card right/bottom for M1.A, M1.B, Tita I, Tita II; (3) tapping module-M1.A navigates to practice with verb-selector-button visible and generate produces card-affirmative text 'I can see.'; (4) module-M1.B produces continuous form 'I can be seeing.'; (5) verb sheet shows exactly the 5 senses (see/touch/smell/taste/hear) each with an Ionicon; (6) result cards show sense emoji (👀) via verb-emoji-affirmative/-negative/-question and speak-* audio buttons are absent as intended. Minor: React Native Web deprecation warnings observed: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated'.

issues: Ionicon 'flower' for 'smell' renders as a small gear/settings-like glyph on RN Web at size 28 — verb LABEL is correct but icon may look ambiguous to kids. Consider a nose/bud icon or rely on the emoji-only chip.

action_items: (Optional) Address RN Web deprecation warnings by migrating 'shadowColor/Opacity/Radius/Offset' to 'boxShadow' and removing pointerEvents prop in favor of style.pointerEvents (informational, no functional impact).
(Optional) Reconsider Ionicons name for 'smell' (currently 'flower') as it renders ambiguously; the emoji 👃 elsewhere is fine.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx footerRow with flex:1 spacer and goCircle flexShrink:0 correctly prevents chevron overflow — verified via bounding-box math.

PracticeScreen.tsx: BACKEND fallback string 'https://dummy.api' is bracketed inside markdown-style link syntax (line 27). Not hit in this flow (env is set), but harmless dead default; consider cleaning up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for module-card chevron overflow verified on 390x844 viewport. All 4 module cards' chevron circles are within card bounds. Senses practice flow works for both M1.A and M1.B; verb sheet shows all 5 sense options with icons; result cards use sense emoji (verb-emoji-*) instead of audio (speak-*).
rca_of_issue: Original bug: forward-arrow icon (previously chevron-forward at ~20px directly in a row without a fixed-width container) overflowed the card's rounded footer when the '<n> tiempos' pill was wide. Fix wraps the chevron in a fixed 26x26 rounded 'goCircle' with flexShrink:0 and adds a flex:1 spacer between the pill and the circle, guaranteeing the circle stays inside the card padding. Verified via getBoundingClientRect: for every card, chevron.right < card.right and chevron.bottom < card.bottom.
